name: summoning-seal-materialise
intent: Seal rings draw via stroke, ticks snap in, then a panel expands from the seal center with clip/scale — not fade.

copy.hintIdle: Press Run to draw the seal.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Seal fully drawn and panel already expanded

acceptance: Outer then inner rings draw via stroke-dash over 300ms/260ms before panel expands
Panel uses clip-path circle + scale from seal center — not opacity fade
Exactly 8 ticks snap-scale in with the inner ring; reduced motion shows MATERIALISED immediately
